title: Governor Type 3
text: IEEE type 3 linearized speed-governing hydro turbine model, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Speed reference (pu)}, {Initial torque (pu)}, {Gate servomotor time constant, T_g (s)} sets the time constant for gate servomotor, {Pilot value time constant, T_p (s)} sets the time constant for pilot value, {Opening gate rate limit, U_o (pu/s)} limits of opening gate rate, {Closing gate rate limit, U_c (pu/s)} limits of closing gate rate, {Maximum gate position, on MVA capability, P_max (pu)} sets the maximum position of gate, {Minimum gate position, on MVA capability, P_min (pu)} sets the minimum position of gate, {Permanent speed droop coefficient, R_perm (pu)}, {Transient speed droop coefficient, R_temp (pu)}, {Governor time constant, T_r (s)} sets the time constant of governor, {Water starting time constant, T_w (s)}, {Penstock coefficient, a_11} sets the penstock dynamics coefficient, {Penstock coefficient, a_13} sets the penstock dynamics coefficient, {Penstock coefficient, a_21} sets the penstock dynamics coefficient and {Penstock coefficient, a_23} sets the penstock dynamics coefficient. Values come from the instance.
